title: Cross-Chemistry Meta-Learning with Frequency-Domain Augmentation for Robust Capacity Retention Prediction in Vanadium Redox Flow Batteries
authors_html: Young-Dae Shim, Junghwan Yim, Nian Liu, Cheong Hoon Kwon, Hae-Jin Choi, Seung-Kyum Choi
summary: Cross-chemistry meta-learning and frequency-domain augmentation for predicting capacity retention in vanadium redox flow batteries.

title: SeeTraceAct: Grounding Vision-Language-Action Models with One-Shot Video Demonstrations via Visual Latent Planning
summary: Learning a visual latent plan from a single demonstration video to guide spatially precise robot actions.
caption: Method overview · official SeeTraceAct project page
details: The workshop paper studies one-shot demonstration-conditioned robot policies and evaluates the approach in RoboCasa. The linked project page presents the related arXiv version and its figures; the publication title here follows the OpenReview workshop version.

title: Rad-R: A Raw-ADC Radar Dataset and Capture-Invariant SSM for Hardware-Fault Diagnosis
authors_html: Mainak Mallick, Junghwan Yim, Alankrit Gupta, Seung-Kyum Choi
summary: A dataset of controlled radar hardware faults, paired with physical measurements, and a state space model for diagnosis across capture conditions.
caption: Vehicle deployment and sensing hardware · Rad-R, Figure 1
details: The dataset records controlled faults such as vibration, antenna misalignment, blockage, and receive-channel degradation. Evaluation distinguishes within-clip performance from cross-severity generalization. The current dataset is single-session, so its generalization claims are limited to the controlled protocol.

title: VibPath: Two-Factor Authentication with Your Hand’s Vibration Response to Unlock Your Phone
authors_html: Seokmin Choi, Junghwan Yim, Se Jun Kim, Yincheng Jin, Di Wu, Zhanpeng Jin
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Interactive, Mobile, Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies (IMWUT), 2023
summary: Using vibration responses between the hand and wrist to authenticate a user while they enter a passcode.
caption: Experimental setup · Seokmin Choi’s research page
details: An attention-based encoder–decoder models individual vibration responses. The study evaluates authentication with 30 participants, together with permanence, vulnerability, usability, and system-overhead studies.

title: EarPPG: Securing Your Identity with Your Ears
authors_html: Seokmin Choi, Junghwan Yim, Yincheng Jin, Yang Gao, Jiyang Li, Zhanpeng Jin
venue: ACM International Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces (IUI), 2023
summary: User authentication through in-ear photoplethysmography signals shaped by individual speaking behavior.
caption: Research overview · Seokmin Choi’s research page
details: EarPPG combines physiological and behavioral signals in a learned authentication model. Evaluation includes 25 participants and experiments involving movement, occlusion, lighting, and permanence.
